mandatory_blocked_domains_note: Zero-budget hosts under standing operator prohibition. The chairman required these on EVERY call, mechanically. SEE parameter_conflict: the tool makes that impossible on any call that also uses allowed_domains, which is every call in this file.
parameter_conflict: PARAMETER CONFLICT DISCOVERED AT SESSION OPEN AND RECORDED BEFORE ANY RESULT ROW WAS READ. WebSearch REFUSES allowed_domains and blocked_domains in the same request: the literal error returned was 'Error: Cannot specify both allowed_domains and blocked_domains in the same request'. The chairman's brief required BOTH on every call. They cannot both be passed. THE RESOLUTION THE ANALYST ADOPTED, STATED SO A LATER SEAT MAY RULE AGAINST IT: on every call the analyst passed a single-host or small allowed_domains list that contains NEITHER prohibited host, which excludes them by construction rather than by parameter, and the analyst then SCREENED all 90 returned rows for both prohibited hosts and reports the count (0). THE RESIDUAL RISK IS NAMED AND NOT WAVED AWAY: analytics/insights.jsonl:198 (2026-09-20) records that allowed_domains DID NOT constrain one multi-host result set, so exclusion-by-construction is not a guarantee, which is why the row screen is reported and not merely promised.
allowed_domains_suffix_matching: OBSERVED THIS SESSION, AND IT IS A FACT ABOUT THE PARAMETER AND NOT ABOUT ANY RESOURCE: allowed_domains admits SUBDOMAINS of the value passed. Call S1 passed exactly ['unctad.org'] and 4 of 10 returned rows are at investmentpolicy.unctad.org, a different host. Call S3 passed exactly ['italaw.com'] and 10 of 10 returned rows are at www.italaw.com. Call S4 passed 'pca-cpa.org' and returned one row at files.pca-cpa.org. CONSEQUENCE THAT MATTERS TO THIS PROJECT: files.pca-cpa.org is NOT on scripts/fetch_relay.py ALLOWED_HOSTS while pca-cpa.org is, so a search restricted to an allowlisted host can hand back a locator the relay may not fetch. THIS DOES NOT RETIRE THE 2026-09-20 LEAK FINDING at analytics/insights.jsonl:198 and that finding is UNCHANGED: the four out-of-set rows recorded there (cdn.clinicaltrials.gov x2, image-ppubs.uspto.gov, www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov) are not subdomains of any value in that call's list, so suffix-matching does not explain them.
prohibited_host_row_screen: Screened all 90 result rows across S1-S6 for the two prohibited hosts. dailyjus.com: 0 rows. unis.unvienna.org: 0 rows. Screen run 2026-09-21 by the analyst over this file's own rows.
out_of_allowlist_row_screen: Screened all 90 rows against scripts/fetch_relay.py ALLOWED_HOSTS as read at commit 256cb6e. 89 rows are at hosts in the set; ONE is not - https://files.pca-cpa.org/pcadocs/... (S4 result 7). That row is therefore not relay-fetchable and no batch row was proposed for it.
